name: Turning Word
description: A word in a small recessed box that turns over to the next word, while the box springs to the new width.

props.name: words
props.description: Words shown in turn. Screen readers hear all of them, separated by commas.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds each word stays. The cycle pauses while the box is off screen, and holds the first word under reduced motion.

props.name: animationDuration
props.description: Seconds for one turn: the old word rolls away over the top edge as the new one rolls in from below, letter by letter.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span, an inline block. Font, size and colour are inherited. Other span props are passed through.
